name: Powder Run 3D
author: Cyberdelia
help: Ski down an endless mountain. Turn the wheel to carve left or right; let go and the skis run straight. Next tucks for speed, Prev ploughs to slow down, Select jumps, Play moves the camera. Miss the pines and boulders. Free Ride goes on for ever. Endless Run gets steeper and thicker with trees as it goes and ends at the third fall. Five slopes, and a seed to ski the same run again.

options.name: steering
options.title: Steering
options.help: Spin: turning the wheel carves, and the skis run straight when you stop. Thumb: rest your thumb right or left of the top of the wheel to carve that way.

options.name: sensitivity
options.title: Wheel sensitivity
options.help: How far a turn of the wheel carves: 1 gentle, 5 sharp.

options.name: hud
options.title: Distance and speed
options.help: Shows how far down the mountain you are and how fast you're going.

options.name: sounds
options.title: Snow sounds
options.help: The hiss of the skis on the snow, louder the faster you go.

options.name: picture
options.title: Picture
options.help: Auto: the picture steps up and down with what the iPod can draw smoothly. Fast: always the plainer picture at 25 frames a second. Detailed: always the finest, which an iPod Video playing music can't keep up with.

options.name: stats
options.title: Frame rate
options.help: Shows the picture's level (Q0 finest to Q4 plainest) and the frames a second.

achievements.name: air
achievements.title: Big Air
achievements.text: Stay in the air for a whole second.

achievements.name: endurance
achievements.title: Endurance
achievements.text: Ski 5 km in an Endless Run.

achievements.name: tour
achievements.title: Grand Tour
achievements.text: Ski 500 m or more on all five slopes.
